description: This script is a Bash shell script used for managing review lifecycle dates (start, stop, clear) for components in a project, specifically manipulating metadata.yaml files, generating reports, and providing user help. It contains functions for date calculations, file editing via sed, and argument parsing for different commands related to review cycles.

external_methods.name: date
external_methods.description: Command-line utility used for date calculations, formatting, and validation.

external_methods.name: sed
external_methods.description: Stream editor used for in-place modifications of YAML files.

external_methods.name: find
external_methods.description: Used to locate 'metadata.yaml' files within the project repository.

external_methods.name: sort
external_methods.description: Sorts the list of components or files.
